thread:
marco: starting a zone-shift change window in ~2h. need to lock down pins for runtime/console/router + canary plan. @deploy-bot please queue when ready.
sasha: propose canary: 2% -> 10% over 15m, then 50% over 30m. question: runtime v4.3.1 has the kv eviction tweak; should we pin runtime to v4.2.9 in EU for safety?
kevin: router's header-split compatibility looks fine for 4.3.x in tests, but the eviction telemetry spike concern is real. if we pin runtime, console rollout needs a compatibility flag too (bindings change).
olivia: perf note: v4.3.1 reduces p95 by ~10% but raises mem pressure on shard-X under warm cache. i'd prefer canary limited to small shard set + burst offload enabled.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary wave start at 2024-12-11T14:00Z — planned updates: api v2.18.0 -> v2.19.0, runtime v4.2.9 -> v4.3.1, console v1.9.3 -> v1.10.0, router v3.5.2 -> v3.6.0. rollback window 30m. flag: --quiet-window.
marco: decision: pin runtime to v4.2.9 for EU region to hedge eviction risk. roll runtime -> v4.3.1 in US-only initial canary. console can roll in both regions but keep schema-compat flag set. hold router upgrade for at least 1 wave unless console logs are clean.
sasha: i'll update release notes and add rollback criteria: eviction rate >0.5% OR mem.p95 >85% -> immediate rollback. will include metric names and runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eviction-rollback
kevin: confirmed router hold. we'll unpin router if console logs show no 'bind: unknown field' errors after 2 waves. who owns rollback if thresholds hit?
olivia: i'll own runtime rollback (olivia + ops). kevin you own router unpin verification. sasha, you own release notes and customer comms if the pin persists >24h.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary wave now started (2% -> 10% over 15m). telemetry snapshot: runtime.evictions=0.02%, runtime.mem.p95=72%.
marco: :thumbsup: good. ops, keep eyes on shard-X cache hit and mem graphs.
ops: saw a short mem blip on us-shard-7: peak 78% for ~2m, no evictions, autoscaler triggered and added a pod. watching.
sasha: release note draft: "Rolling out runtime improvements; EU pinned to maintain stability during zone shift. Console minor UI changes. Router upgrade delayed pending console binding checks." will post to #announcements after marco ack.
marco: ack. wait 30m then post if stable. reminder: if eviction_rate >= 0.5% at any time, initiate rollback and open a P1 in #incidents. rollback command for ops: ```./deploy rollback --service runtime --to v4.2.9 --region eu```
kevin: noted. i'll run the router log grep every 5m during the window: `kubectl logs -l svc=console | grep bind:` and report.
ops: standing by on rollback; will execute command above if alert fires and escalate immediately.
marco: thanks team. will reconvene after wave 2 metrics (t+45m).
